items.title: Garment unrest clouds fragile economic recovery
items.description: Wage protests by garment workers entered a fourth day yesterday, forcing several hundred factories to close, as fresh economic data pointed to a fragile and uneven recovery.

items.title: Dhaka, Seoul to form investment working group
items.description: Bangladesh and South Korea have agreed to set up a joint government-private sector working group following the conclusion of negotiations on a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA).

items.title: Stock brokerages caught between clicks and paperwork
items.description: Investors traditionally had to visit stock brokerage offices in person to collect and fill out forms and submit documents to open beneficiary owner (BO) accounts.

items.title: India faces prolonged food inflation
items.description: Indian farmer Amarsingh Gushinge wants to sow wheat and chickpeas in coming weeks to capitalise on attractive prices, but dwindling water supplies after below-average monsoon rains are preventing him from planting either crop.

items.title: Europe to enter winter with lowest gas reserves since 2013: IEA
items.description: Europe is entering winter with its lowest level of natural gas reserves since 2013, which could extend pressure on the international market into 2027, the International Energy Agency warned Tuesday.
